name: endpoint-record
mutation: return (policy === 'cluster' ? all : all.filter((p) => p.node === node)).map((p) => ({ ...p, node: p.node + 1 }));
pattern: for any placement, the shares sum to 1 and follow each policy’s rule

name: wcag-obsolete

name: ring-empty-nonmutation
mutation: if (!this.length) { this.head = (this.head + 1) % this.capacity; throw new Error('Empty'); }
pattern: ring wraps into freed slots and Full changes no state
